machineLearning.name: RLVR-Predictor
description: Predicts post-RLVR lift before training using a LightGBM model trained on GRPO rollout features
Reached 78% batch-ranking accuracy and 34% faster NLL convergence fine-tuning Qwen 3 on H100s

machineLearning.name: Quantum Neural Networks
description: CUDA-accelerated QNN modules and ops with full autograd support, written for a from-scratch deep learning framework
Outperformed classical networks by 21–42% on 3 entanglement detection tasks by exploiting phase information

machineLearning.name: LSTM Stock Prediction
description: LSTM network predicting Apple's closing stock prices, reaching a 4.93% MAE and an R² of 0.97
Processed Yahoo Finance time-series data by normalizing features and building 100-day sliding windows for sequential input

machineLearning.name: Train of Thought
description: Multi-agent LLM system built on Google Gemini that does chain-of-thought reasoning with recursive subproblem validation
Added agent backtracking, prompt decomposition, safety and correctness validation, and output critique
Tested the chat interface on 20+ programming puzzles for a ~80% increase in passed tests over the base model

machineLearning.name: TexPilot
description: GitHub Copilot-style browser extension for LaTeX code generation, autocompletion, and explanations with LLaMA 2
Real-time (<450ms) Python backend serving context-aware completions over LaTeX code and docs indexed with LlamaIndex

machineLearning.name: PDD Model (AI4ALL)
description: ResNet-9 computer vision model identifying 38 plant diseases with 93% accuracy
Iterated through 3 architectures, sourced and augmented the training data, and tracked runs with Weights & Biases
Deployed with AWS SageMaker and presented at Carnegie Mellon's AI4ALL research program

machineLearning.name: Object Detection and Bounding CNN (AI4ALL)
description: CNN that identifies and bounds common road objects in a scene, aimed at autonomous driving
Benchmarked 3 approaches — Perceptron, Sliding Windows, and YOLO — reaching 95% accuracy with VGG-16

systems.name: File-Caching Proxy
description: Low-latency distributed system for remote file operations using a server, caching proxy, and interposition library
Cut file access latency 70% under simulated load with an LRU chunk cache hitting a 90% hit rate
Server-proxy protocol over Java RMI handling 300+ concurrent clients with consistent open-close semantics

systems.name: Dynamic Memory Allocator
description: Dynamic memory allocation system in C using segregated free lists, granular fit algorithms, and block-level optimizations
Hit the 98th percentile for utilization and throughput — 22 million operations per second at 74.4% utilization

systems.name: Linear Algebraic Methods in Image Compression
description: Co-authored paper reviewing mathematical methods for extracting structure from common data representations
Treats digital images as a dense, highly redundant medium and focuses on algorithms that exploit linear-algebraic structure for sizeable compression ratios
Defines the mathematical tools behind each algorithm, then compares the techniques quantitatively and visually on a sampled data set

systems.name: FireFinder
description: Real-time pipeline for fire detection and location-based evacuation routing within 3 seconds of a fire outbreak
Built a prototype ESP8266-based fire detector streaming sensor data over AWS IoT, with S3 and Lambda triggering alerts

robots.caption: We were part of the science division at the VEX World Championship.
I designed, built, and programmed this robot during spring of 2022 (this was the final iteration).

I added systems like pneumatic pistons (at about 100psi) and 8 DC Motors to perform tasks. Also uses inertial sensors and other sensors (added after this picture) like optical sensors, distance sensors, and GPS sensors to navigate the field. The robot operates on a 6 motor drivebase and reaches speeds of 280rpm on 4 inch wheels. Uses center traction wheels to climb up platforms and omnidirectional wheels to increase manueverability.
